panels.title: 7C review and quiz: muscles and bones
Explain why breathing and heart rate rise when you climb stairs. (4 marks)
points: Leg muscles contract more, so they respire faster
This needs more oxygen and glucose
Breathing rate rises to take in more oxygen
Heart rate rises to deliver it faster and remove carbon dioxide
Answer: Four linked points, each building on the last
